description: This file defines the 'Content' class which manages content data within a documentation or website generator. It handles front matter parsing, content retrieval and setting, navigation links to previous/next content, and attribute management.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Represents a content node with front matter parsing, navigation, and attribute management capabilities within a content tree.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Content instance with a parent directory, URI, and optional file info.

methods.name: getFrontMatter
methods.description: Parses front matter from the content, returning front matter data and content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content string, parsing attributes if necessary.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content manually and marks the content as manually set.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Determines if this content is an index page based on URI and configuration.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title from attributes or parent implementation.

methods.name: parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses front matter attributes from content.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute or all attributes.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array dump including previous/next URLs and attributes.
